description.value: Miu Japanese Cuisine is a contemporary fusion restaurant in Port Coquitlam offering a creative East-meets-West take on Japanese cooking, with specialties including aburi oshi sushi, sushi pizza, and bento sets. The restaurant describes its philosophy as a respectful yet imaginative reinterpretation of traditional Japanese flavors incorporating West Coast influences. It caters to a wide range of occasions, from solo meals to group gatherings.
